slice.label: Subdomain slice inside the context, dash-case (e.g. invoicing)

name.label: Use case in PascalCase, a business action from the context's glossary (e.g. IssueInvoice)

driven_ports.label: Comma-separated driven ports the use case needs, PascalCase. Omit to read them from the use case's row in domain-model.md; a flag may only agree with the doc. Each port must already exist (hex-driven-port).

description: New use case in a slice, read from its row in the Use cases table of domain-model.md (driven ports, feature) and from the feature itself: application/<Name>.ts (command, result, the use case type, its Symbol token and a make<Name> factory that receives its driven ports), steps/<Name>.steps.ts (one pending quickpickle step definition per distinct phrase of the feature), the provider in the slice's composition.ts (useFactory with the port tokens as inject) and the token and type re-exports in the context barrel. The row and its .feature must already exist in the docs: generators never invent contracts. Idempotent: an existing use case is left alone.
